I'm a postdoc at the Department of Mathematical Sciences at the University of Copenhagen, where I'm working in the [Copenhagen Causality Lab](https://www.math.ku.dk/english/research/spt/cocala/).

Previously, I was a PhD student in the [Statistical Methods for Causal Inference](https://www.bips-institut.de/en/the-institute/departments/statistical-methods-in-epidemiology/statistical-methods-for-causal-inference.html) group at the Leibniz Institute for Prevention Research and Epidemiology - BIPS in Bremen.

My research interests include graphical models and causal inference, and my current work focuses on causal discovery.

Contact: cwb [at] math [dot] ku [dot] dk
